sentences.title: When did you/will you go to ... ?
lines: Have you ever been to Athens?你去过雅典吗？ No, I have never.没有。 现在完成时 引起话题
Will you go there?打算去吗？ When will you go there?打算什么时候去？ I will go there next year.打算明年去。 一般将来时 具体谈论
Have you ever been to Berlin?你去过柏林吗？ Yes, I have .去过。 现在完成时 引起话题

When did you go ?什么时候去的？ I went there last year.去年去的。 Who did you go with?和谁一块去的？ I went there with my boyfriend.和我男朋友一起去的。 I went there last year. When did you go there? I went there with my boyfriend. Who went there with you? 一般过去时 具体谈论

expand.title: 综合应用各种时态
lines: 张一山是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。他是个演员。 Zhang Yishan is our new next-door neighbor. He is an actor.
他曾在北京五十五中学读书。 He was in No.55 middle school in Beijing.
下个月他将飞往山东。下下个月他将飞往香港。现在他在上海。 The next month He will fly to Shandong. The month after next he will fly to Hong Kong. At the moment, he is in Shanghai.
他是一星期以前飞到上海的。再下个星期他将返回北京。 He flew to Shanghai a week ago. He will return to Beijing the week after next.
他只有 21 岁，但他几乎去过中国的每一个地方了。 He is only twenty-one years old, and he has been to nearly every place in China.
张一山是个很幸运的人。但他的爸爸运气不是很好。他总是呆在北京。 Zhang Yishan is a lucky person. But his father is not very lucky. He usually stays in Beijing.
